description:
Developer - Policy Admin Systems 
Full time - Hybrid, Springfield/Boston
 *** Candidate will be expected to work a hybrid schedule, including a minimum of three days per week in the office *** 
 
 The Opportunity 
 MassMutual’s Product Technology team is seeking a Mainframe Engineer – TradV Modernization to support the modernization and ongoing transformation of our TradV (Traditional Vantage) platforms as part of MassMutual’s broader Product Manufacturing strategy. This role will help modernize critical life insurance administration platforms while balancing ongoing support for existing mainframe systems.
 You will work closely with our global business and technology teams to support new product development, system integration, and platform optimization efforts. This is a hands-on technical role with opportunities to contribute to both development and production support across a high-impact modernization roadmap.
 
 The Team 
 The Product Technology organization enables MassMutual’s life insurance and disability income product lines, delivering new product launches, supporting policy administration systems, and driving modernization across legacy and cloud platforms. The TradV Modernization team works across Mainframe and Cloud technologies, partnering closely with Product Manufacturing, Engineering, Architecture, and Operations to support MassMutual’s Product portfolio expansion and platform consolidation efforts.
 
 The Impact: 
 Mainframe Development & Modernization 
 Support TradV modernization, product builds, and administration platform enhancements across Life, DI, and Annuity products.
 Lead and execute development using COBOL, JCL, CICS, DB2, VSAM, and Micro Focus COBOL.
 Support modernization efforts across hybrid platforms, including Mainframe-to-Cloud transitions.
 Analyze performance differences between legacy and cloud implementations and drive optimization efforts.
 
 Product Delivery & System Integration 
 Work closely with business analysts, product teams, and architects to translate new product specifications into scalable mainframe system changes.
 Support multiple product launches annually as part of MassMutual’s Product Manufacturing strategy.
 Collaborate on cross-platform integration involving Vantage, wMA, and modern cloud-based systems.
 Partner with developers, QA, and production support teams to ensure seamless delivery across SDLC phases.
 
 Production Support & Operations 
 Provide Tier 2/Tier 3 support for ongoing production issues across TradV systems.
 Participate in on-call rotations to resolve incidents, triage failures, and address performance issues.
 Perform root cause analysis and implement permanent solutions to improve platform stability.
 
 Platform Modernization & Cloud Readiness 
 Drive modernization initiatives, including Mainframe-to-Cloud migrations where applicable.
 Support containerization, DevOps, and CI/CD adoption as modernization progresses.
 Collaborate with platform, cloud, and DevSecOps teams on secure, compliant infrastructure enablement.
 
 The Minimum Qualifications 
 Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related technical field
 8+ years of experience in software development, including experience in Senior Developer or Technical Lead roles
 5+ years experience with a combination of the technologies: COBOL, Micro Focus COBOL, JCL, CICS, VSAM, DB2
 CA7 and Zena Scheduler
 Xpeditor, Endevor
 Java/J2EE knowledge helpful for hybrid work
 Platform modernization and performance tuning
 Hybrid Mainframe-Cloud architectures
 
 
 The Ideal Qualifications 
 8+ years experience in Life Insurance domain experience (highly preferred)
 wMA / Vantage platform experience
 Cloud platform experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
 DevOps pipeline experience (CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes)
 Cloud-based mainframe modernization tools
 Certifications in ITIL, Agile, or Mainframe modernization technologies
 Strong problem-solving, debugging, and data flow analysis skills
 Ability to visualize and analyze data flow across complex insurance administration platforms
 Clear communication skills for collaboration with business and technology partners
 Eagerness to learn new technologies and evolve with modernization efforts
 Strong ownership mindset, ability to work across development, testing, and support functions
 
 What You Can Expect at MassMutual 
 
 MassMutual offers the opportunity to do meaningful work within a purpose-driven organization that values long-term impact over short-term outcomes. In this role, you can expect:
 Clear areas of ownership and accountability, with work that connects directly to company and customer outcomes 
 A collaborative environment where perspectives are welcomed  
 Access to learning, development, and internal networks that support continuous growth and skill-building over time 
 Employee-led communities and forums that foster connection, learning, and inclusion across the organization 
 A culture grounded in integrity, responsibility, and stewardship—supported by a company with a strong legacy and a future-focused mindset
 
 #LI-RK1
 
 Salary Range: 
$148,300-$194,600 

 At MassMutual, we focus on ensuring fair equitable pay, by providing competitive salaries, along with incentive and bonus opportunities for all employees. Your total compensation package includes either a bonus target or in a sales-focused role a Variable Incentive Compensation component. 
 Why Join Us. 
 
 We’ve been around since 1851. During our history, we’ve learned a few things about making sure our customers are our top priority. In order to meet and exceed their expectations, we must have the best people providing the best thinking, products and services. To accomplish this, we celebrate an inclusive, vibrant and diverse culture that encourages growth, openness and opportunities for everyone. A career with MassMutual means you will be part of a strong, stable and ethical business with industry leading pay and benefits. And your voice will always be heard.
 
 We help people secure their future and protect the ones they love. As a company owned by our policyowners, we are defined by mutuality and our vision to put customers first. It’s more than our company structure – it’s our way of life. We are a company of people protecting people. Our company exists because people are willing to share risk and resources, and rely on each other when it counts. At MassMutual, we Live Mutual.
 
 MassMutual is an equal employment opportunity employer. We welcome all persons to apply. 
 
 If you need an accommodation to complete the application process, please  contact us  and share the specifics of the assistance you need. 
   
 At MassMutual, we focus on ensuring fair, equitable pay by providing competitive salaries, along with incentive and bonus opportunities for all employees.  Your total compensation package includes either a bonus target or in a sales-focused role a Variable Incentive Compensation component.  For more information about our extensive benefits offerings please check out our Total Rewards at a Glance.
